svg.aria-label: Four stages of the strangler fig pattern: a client talks to a monolith holding users, orders, inventory and payments over one database; then an API gateway routes order requests to a new order service with its own database and everything else to the monolith, which keeps the remaining tables; then user and inventory services are extracted too, each with its own database, leaving only payments in the monolith; dashed edges carry the remaining requests to the monolith; finally, only if every module earns extraction, four services each own their own database and the monolith is gone
svg.text: Strangler fig pattern: extracting services from a monolith
Route one feature at a time to a new service, extracting only the modules that have a reason to leave.
All functionality in a single application.
Route requests for one feature to a new service.
If every module earns extraction, the monolith is removed.
